The sheet lists 276 exercises across 27 sections once the “odd” ranges are written out. The course outline (page 4) says of this list: “Doing these exercises is how you will learn,” and its B-grade checklist includes “Do all the homework exercises.” The outline does not describe these as handed in for marks.

Where the sheet prints a range such as “41–49 odd”, the buttons show each number separately (41, 43, 45, 47, 49) and the printed wording is kept underneath.

✎ Explanation (added)

Weekdays are added from the 2026 calendar: lectures are on Wednesdays and Fridays, and both tests are on Fridays. On days where the sheet lists two sections against one date (Sept 11, Sept 25, Oct 9, Dec 2), both are shown with that date.

The two handouts disagree by a day: this sheet prints “Exam period: Dec 11–20”, while the course outline says Dec 11–19. Keep Dec 20 free until the College posts the actual exam date.

The sheet does not say which sections each test covers. Going only by position, 12.1 to 14.3 are scheduled before Test 1 and 14.4 to 15.3 fall between the two tests; confirm the actual coverage in class.
